content: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
story:
Devastated by the tragic deaths of his young wife Ellen and beloved brothers, Emerson resigned from the Unitarian ministry in Boston, journeyed across Europe, and emerged as the prophet of American Transcendentalism. From his quiet study in Concord, Massachusetts, he summoned humanity to cast off cowardly imitation, trust their divine inner instincts, and commune directly with nature's Over-Soul.

This insight points directly back to the quiet center of being. Ralph Waldo Emerson observed that while the mind perpetually scatters itself into past regrets and future anxieties, peace is only ever discovered by anchoring attention in the immediate truth of this moment.
reflectionPrompt: Take a conscious breath right now: how much of your current stress exists only in your anticipation of tomorrow?
